Implementation Lens / Repository-Driven Delivery

Release Pipeline Implementation Map

Code-derived stages and script execution chains from monorepo checkout to staging and production rollout.

Reading Notes

System Shape

  • The monorepo is the single trigger source: checkout, test runs, and compilation all read directly from it.
  • Lint, unit tests, and the build script form the CI pipeline; delivery handles artifacts and rollouts.

Critical Flows

  • The build script publishes a versioned tarball to the artifact store; the deploy script pulls that exact artifact.
  • Staging is rolled out first; the same artifact is promoted to production only after staging verification.

Operational Notes

  • Every stage is a repo script, so the map stays code-derived and reproducible on any runner.
  • Rollback re-runs the deploy script against the previous artifact version (assumption).
